name: Deafening Thunder
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a thunderstone)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 40-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create an explosion of deafening sound in the area. Each creature in the area takes 1d8 sonic damage per two caster levels (maximum 10d8) and are permanently deafened. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and reduces the deafness to 1 round.
